_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The composer restores each terminal's explicit exit policy after reload. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-policy. "The held command" is: bash -c 'read -r answer; echo "$answer"'. "The terminal input" is the visible terminal's input, '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]' (other terminals' inputs are hidden); to type into it, focus it with an eval (.focus()), then use type steps, which type key by key, and press_key for Enter or Control+d. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-policy. Send "!" followed by the held command (fill [data-testid="message-input"] with it and click [data-testid="send-button"]), then send "!bash". There should be exactly 2 ".terminal-panel-tab-running".
2. Call "closeOnExit" (the close_on_exit of this conversation's terminals on the server, oldest first) should return exactly [false,true].
3. Reload. There should be exactly 2 ".terminal-panel-tab-running" again.
4. Type "exit 7" into the terminal input (the "!bash" terminal, which is the visible one) and press Enter.
5. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab", and ".terminal-panel-tab-active" should have the title attribute exactly the held command.
6. A shell running a one-shot command retains output even though its executable is the same as the interactive shell that just closed: type "retained-after-reload" into the terminal input (now the held command's) and press Enter. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-success".
7. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input". The message input's value should contain "retained-after-reload".
